prompt: In an anime style illustration, a sunlit library reading room buzzes with quiet activity. On the far left, a girl in a blue beret sits on a wooden chair, her posture slumped as she reads a thick hardcover book. Next to her, a black cat sleeps curled on the rug, its tail twitching slightly. In the center foreground, a boy with spiky hair leans over a table, pointing at a map spread before him while a girl with glasses looks at the same map intently. A stack of three yellow books rests on the table edge near the boy's elbow. Behind them, a librarian in a green vest stands by a tall shelf, handing a returned novel to a man in a red scarf who reaches out to take it. To the right, an elderly woman in a floral dress sits on a bench, knitting a long gray scarf that pools around her feet. Beside her, a small brown dog lies flat on the floor, watching a butterfly flutter near the window. Near the back wall, two students whisper; one wears a hoodie and holds a pencil, while the other, in a plaid shirt, listens with hands clasped. A large globe stands on a pedestal between the whispering pair and the central table. Above the globe, a clock shows the time as three o'clock. A potted fern sits on a side table to the right of the globe, its leaves drooping slightly. There is no digital technology visible in the scene, ensuring a timeless atmosphere. There is no food or drink present on any surfaces, maintaining the strict library rules. The light streams through high arched windows, casting long shadows across the polished floorboards. The girl in the blue beret glances up from her book, looking at the black cat beside her. The man in the red scarf smiles faintly as he accepts the book from the librarian in the green vest. The boy with spiky hair taps the map again, emphasizing a route to the girl with glasses. The elderly woman in the floral dress pauses her knitting to look at the small brown dog next to her. The student in the hoodie gestures with the pencil toward the student in the plaid shirt. The butterfly lands briefly on the leaf of the potted fern. Every character displays distinct clothing patterns and hairstyles typical of detailed animation art. The shelves are packed with colorful spines, creating a vibrant backdrop. The wooden furniture shows signs of wear, adding texture to the scene. The overall composition balances static readers with dynamic interactions, creating a lively yet peaceful study environment.
